items.title: Can I change plans later?
items.content: Yes. Upgrade or downgrade at any time; the difference is prorated on your next invoice.

items.title: Is there a free trial?
items.content: The Pro plan includes a 14-day free trial. No credit card is required to start.

items.title: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.content: All major credit cards and bank transfer for yearly plans.

items.title: Can I cancel anytime?

name: FAQ
description: Frequently asked questions in groups, plus a "still need help?" box.

content.text:
Frequently asked questions

Quick answers to the questions we hear most often.

items.title: How do I create an account?
items.content: Click "Sign up", enter your email and choose a password. It takes less than a minute.

items.title: Do I need to install anything?
items.content: No. Everything works in your browser on desktop, tablet and phone.

items.title: Is there a free plan?
items.content: Yes. The free plan covers the basics and you can upgrade at any time.

items.title: How do I change my password?
items.content: Open your account settings and choose "Change password".

items.title: Where can I find my invoices?
items.content: All invoices are available to download from the billing section of your account.

items.title: How do I cancel my subscription?
items.content: You can cancel from the billing section; access continues until the end of the period.

items.title: Is my data safe?
items.content: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and backed up every day.

items.title: Can I export or delete my data?
items.content: Yes. You can export everything or ask us to delete your account at any time.

content.title: Still need help?
content.text: Our team usually replies within one business day.
